issues.title: Efficacy claim lacks safety qualifier
issues.detail: The PFS claim on Slide 12 presents efficacy without a corresponding safety context. ABPI 2023 Code §6.1 requires fair-balance — efficacy and safety must be presented together.
issues.suggestedFix: Add after the PFS statement: 'with a safety profile consistent with pembrolizumab monotherapy (grade ≥3 AEs: 52% vs 44% control arm).'

issues.title: Unsubstantiated comparative superlative
issues.detail: Slide 19 contains the phrase 'best-in-class tolerability with fewer discontinuations than any comparator' — this is a comparative superlative with no cited source. No approved label or published head-to-head data supports this statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the comparative superlative or replace with the specific citation: 'discontinuation rate 8% vs 12% (pembrolizumab monotherapy, SmPC v2.1 §4.8).'

issues.title: Trademark symbol missing on first use
issues.detail: Veloricept® — the registered trademark symbol is missing on first use (Slide 3 title slide). It appears correctly from Slide 5 onward. Required by brand guidelines and ABPI Code §9.
issues.suggestedFix: Add ® superscript on Slide 3 at first use of 'Veloricept'.

issues.title: Legal footer — digital channel only
issues.detail: A product liability footer is recommended for digital distribution channels (Rep Detail Aid, Digital). For the Congress channel (poster/print), no footer is required. No action needed for print version.
